name: openclacky
tagline_zh: 开源AI代理，Token消耗砍半。同样的任务，别人烧钱你省钱，还能自己改代码。
tagline_en: Open-source AI agent that halves token usage. Same tasks, half the cost, and you can tweak the code.
desc_en: The most Token-efficient open-source AI Agent
why_zh: 不是靠压缩提示，而是用动态上下文管理，实测省50%以上，且完全可定制。
why_en: Not prompt compression, but dynamic context management. Cuts token use by 50%+ and is fully customizable.
